description: This file defines data structures and functions related to flattening and unflattening Python arguments and variables in the PyTorch JIT compiler, including IODescriptor, VariableMetadata, and ParsedArgs.

classes.name: IODescriptor
classes.description: Represents the structure and metadata of function arguments for flattening/unflattening.

classes.name: IODescriptor::VariableMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata about a variable, including size, type, device, and gradient requirement.

classes.name: ParsedArgs
classes.description: Holds flattened variables and their argument structure metadata.

methods.name: operator<< (IODescriptor::VariableMetadata)
methods.description: Outputs variable metadata details to a stream.

methods.name: operator<< (IODescriptor)
methods.description: Outputs IODescriptor details to a stream.

methods.name: extend (IODescriptor)
methods.description: Extends IODescriptor with a list of variables.

methods.name: extend (ParsedArgs)
methods.description: Extends ParsedArgs with a list of variables.
